root_cause.check_implicated: candidate assembly in scripts/git/auto_integrator.py (around line 588-648) reads coordination.repositories.pantheon.integration_path from the resolved live config and sets TaskCandidate.dedicated_integration_path = bool(integration_path_raw). integrate_candidate() (line ~2300-2345) fails closed with reason `missing-dedicated-integration-path` and opens this unblock task whenever `--execute` is combined with require_dedicated_integration_path=True and that flag is empty -- this is intentional hardening from SUP-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-DEDICATED-ROOT-20260828, which stops live execution from ever merging using a repository's shared worker/source local_path.
root_cause.observed_live_config: The promoted live config at /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json currently renders coordination.repositories.pantheon as {"repo": "ajoe734/pantheon"} and coordination.repositories.execute_plans as {"repo": "ajoe734/execute-plans", "local_path": "../code/execute-plans"} -- neither entry carries an integration_path key, so both repositories currently fail the dedicated-checkout gate for --execute, not only pantheon.
root_cause.expected_mechanism: scripts/sync-dev-root.sh is the normal promotion driver. On every run it materializes a dedicated, HEAD-pinned, clean clone per repository under ${INTEGRATION_RUNTIME_PARENT}/<repo_id>/<target_sha> via materialize_integration_runtime() (lines 208-217), then invokes scripts/promote-supervisor-runtime.sh --promote with --repository-integration-root pantheon=<that path> and --repository-integration-root execute_plans=<that path> (lines 423-431), which provision_live_supervisor_config.py renders into the live config's coordination.repositories.<id>.integration_path.

The newest, f15be762ef373cd24707b89e5b9b286650b9a097, was last modified 2026-09-17T09:44:36Z. A parallel trace log at /tmp/sync-dev-root-trace.log (2026-09-08T09:54-09:55Z, from an earlier promotion attempt) shows the exact invocation shape sync-dev-root.sh uses, including both --repository-integration-root flags, confirming the mechanism is real and has run successfully in the recent past for both repositories.
root_cause.current_gap: The currently active command runtime, /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/command-runtimes/e7db147f6a31f4af5754de7943d6edc4e08d3e4b, was promoted at 2026-09-17T23:29:32Z (directory mtime) -- roughly 14 hours after the newest existing dedicated pantheon checkout (f15be762..., 09:44:36Z) and well after the newest execute_plans one (a4305744569f9e6f2105613ed8ca9761f540e9bc, 2026-09-17T18:45Z). Either this promotion cycle bypassed scripts/sync-dev-root.sh's normal path, an earlier step in that path failed non-fatally in a way that still let promotion proceed, or a subsequent config write dropped the previously-rendered keys. resolution.reason_no_code_change: auto_integrator.py's require_dedicated_integration_path gate is intentional, tested hardening (SUP-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-DEDICATED-ROOT-20260828) and is doing exactly its job: refusing to merge through an unvalidated/shared checkout. The defect, if any, is in why the most recent live-supervisor promotion did not (re)populate coordination.repositories.pantheon.integration_path the way scripts/sync-dev-root.sh's documented flow does; that promotion pipeline and the live config/integration-runtimes state it writes to live entirely on the host under pantheon-ci-deploy/ and are out of this task's declared artifact contract and out of a background code-review worker's safe authority to blindly re-run (provision_live_supervisor_config.py fully re-renders the live config from --command-root plus whatever flags are passed; running it without reproducing the exact prior invocation's other parameters, e.g. --python/--requirements, risks regressing unrelated live config fields on the one shared production supervisor).
resolution.action_taken: Documented root cause with reproducing evidence (config inspection, integration-runtimes/ directory audit, GitHub tag/status checks) in this manifest. Did not attempt to mutate the live supervisor config or re-run promotion tooling directly, per the caution owed to a shared, hard-to-reverse production control-plane surface. Filed a canonical blocker directing the runtime-packaging/CI-CD lane to re-run scripts/sync-dev-root.sh (or otherwise supply --repository-integration-root pantheon=<fresh dedicated clean clone of ajoe734/pantheon at the active command_runtime_sha> to scripts/provision_live_supervisor_config.py / promote-supervisor-runtime.sh) so the live config regains integration_path for both pantheon and execute_plans, after which the auto-integrator can retry OPS-REVIEW-DISPATCH-DIRTY-PR-HOLD-001 / PR #5906 on its own schedule.
recommended_remediation: Re-run scripts/sync-dev-root.sh for the current dev tip (or the currently promoted command_runtime_sha) so materialize_integration_runtime() (re)creates integration-runtimes/pantheon/<sha> and integration-runtimes/execute_plans/<sha> and promote-supervisor-runtime.sh renders both --repository-integration-root values into the live config.

If sync-dev-root.sh cannot be re-run as-is, confirm why the 2026-09-17T23:29:32Z promotion diverged from its normal path (out-of-band invocation, a non-fatal failure inside materialize_integration_runtime, or a later config write) before re-running, so the same gap does not recur on the next promotion.

After the live config carries integration_path for pantheon again, no further action is needed on PR #5906/OPS-REVIEW-DISPATCH-DIRTY-PR-HOLD-001: the auto-integrator's normal cron will pick the review_approved task back up (it is not stale-checked-out) and complete the tag-push + merge flow.
